item.description: TUSCALOOSA, Ala. (WIAT) -- Charles Bediako's request for a preliminary injunction has been denied, effectively ending his basketball career at the University of Alabama. item.title: AHSAA approves expansion of Class 6A football playoffs to 24 teams
